identity: University of Amsterdam, English full-time Global Communication Science track, registry row 415 and RIO 56615. Exact named route within the programme that also offers Dutch Communicatiewetenschap.
sourceUse: The public English-route table sets the components, credits and compulsory/elective categories. The 2026–2027 official catalogue confirms the programme, 180 EC, and dedicated Global Communication Science track, but its retrieved programme response does not include individual course content. The degree overview corroborates the English-route academic focus.
components: Introduction to Global Communication Science: Global and Comparative Perspectives
Communication Science in Practice 1: Global Case Studies
Research and report within an internationally oriented organisation.
Communication Science in Practice 2: The Internship Case
Elective space, minor or international exchange
Genuinely open choice; no topic or minor is selected.
A restricted communication-science course; the UvA gives Content Marketing and Sports and Communication as examples, not compulsory titles.

progression.first-year: Introductory theory and methods in periods 1–3 precede content analysis, survey and experimental work. Skills Bootcamp runs across the year.
progression.second-year: Advanced statistics and qualitative work and global case studies precede the compulsory 24 EC supervised international internship, followed by the 6 EC case drawn from the internship.
progression.third-year: 30 EC open first semester, 6 EC restricted communication elective, 18 EC independent research project in periods 4–5 and 6 EC communicating the research in period 6. No unsupported numerical entry threshold was introduced.
